name: poojaram/DiscoverTube
description: This repository consists of a website created for Client-Side Development coursework. Outcomes of this project: (1)  Produce web pages that are well-formed, standards-compliant, semantically rich, and universally accessible. (2) Style the appearance of those pages to create intuitive, usable, and engaging experiences for human readers on different kinds of devices. (3) Create interactive and feature-rich web applications leveraging existing programming frameworks, libraries, and APIs. (4) Interpret documentation in order to harness existing software packages for web development. (5) Utilize development tools to automatically manage, implement, and validate web applications.
